items.hook: An open-source Python package achieves over 99 percent fidelity reconstructing quantum density matrices.

items.title: PureSuperQMA(exp) = BellPureSymQMA(poly) = QMA via Dimension-Free Bosonic Argmax
items.hook: We prove a surprising complexity collapse, showing that QMA equals PureSuperQMA and related models.

items.title: PPT states of almost maximal Schmidt number
items.hook: We construct PPT states whose Schmidt numbers approach the smaller local dimension.

items.title: The cost of simulating classically tractable quantum circuits and dynamics
items.hook: Quantum simulation can actually be faster than polynomial-time classical algorithms under realistic hardware prices.

items.title: Oracle Separations in the Fourier Hierarchy
items.hook: We prove that adding more Hadamard layers strictly increases quantum computational power for every constant level.

items.title: Block entropy area based non-local fermionic mode optimization with gradient disentanglers
items.hook: A new gradient disentangler slashes quantum entanglement to efficiently simulate 2D fermions and Fe4S4 clusters.

items.title: Absolutely Maximally Entangled States of $2q$ Parties in Every Odd Prime-Power Dimension $q$
items.hook: New maximally entangled quantum states constructed for 2q parties in every odd prime-power dimension q.

items.title: Strong Converse for Quantum Capacity via a Fully Quantum Blowing-Up Lemma
items.hook: Transmitting above quantum capacity causes fidelity to decay exponentially for all memoryless channels.

items.title: For Whom Does Bell Hold?
items.hook: Quantum vacuum fluctuations leave distinct statistical footprints that classical physics cannot mimic.

items.title: Noether Symmetries Generate Deterministic Energy-Harvesting Protocols
items.hook: Continuous Noether symmetries can turn noisy energy sources into deterministic, zero-entropy fuel.

items.title: Private communication via zero-private-capacity quantum channels
items.hook: Two quantum channels with zero private capacity can combine to transmit over 0.0001903 secret bits per use.

items.title: Optimal Low-Rank Quantum State Tomography with Bounded-Sample Joint Measurements
items.hook: Joint measurements on t quantum samples improve state estimation efficiency by at most a factor of √t.

items.title: Phase transitions in first-detection statistics of monitored long-range quantum walks
items.hook: A sharp phase transition at exponent α=1 decides whether a monitored long-range quantum walker ever returns home.

items.title: Information Causality Characterizes the Set of Quantum Correlations in the Simplest Bell Scenario
items.hook: Information causality directly recovers the exact boundary of quantum correlations in the simplest Bell setup.

items.title: Green's Functions from Sample-based Krylov Quantum Diagonalization: An Impurity Solver for Dynamical Mean-Field Theory
items.hook: A new quantum algorithm calculates single-particle Green's functions using shallow circuits and short-time evolutions.

items.title: Large-scale dynamics of integrable quenches
items.hook: New path-integral approach extends Ballistic Macroscopic Fluctuation Theory to solve integrable quench dynamics.

items.title: Near-optimal synthesis of non-Gaussian phase gates via qubit-oscillator Rabi control
items.hook: A new Rabi control scheme synthesizes non-Gaussian phase gates with polylogarithmic time scaling near the lower bound.

items.title: Anderson orthogonality scaling in the Rabi-driven heavy Fermi polaron
items.hook: We observed a power-law dependence of the measured Rabi frequency on the drive strength, consistent with AOC predictions.

items.title: Few-body bound states in the anyon-Hubbard model
items.hook: The anyon-Hubbard model hosts exact two-body bound states and genuine three- and four-body bound states.

items.title: Impossibility of One-Way One-Round Quantum 4-Coloring via Matrix-Space Stability
items.hook: One-way one-round quantum LOCAL algorithms cannot 4-color directed cycles with high probability.

items.title: QROB: Quantifying Realization Overhead in Quantum Compilation via Reverse Construction
items.hook: Existing quantum compilers incur up to 24.1x excess SWAP costs, but QROB closes the gap to boost physical survival by 1.65x.

items.title: Towards Scaling Quantum Fine-Tuning of Foundational Time Series Models for Classification
items.hook: A quantum head outperforms a larger classical multilayer perceptron on identical inputs by 1.7-2.0 percentage points.

items.title: Parametric and feedback-controlled multiparameter quantum estimation in a double cavity optomechanics: steady and dynamical state
items.hook: Parametric amplification can substantially reduce precision bounds, demonstrating an enhancement of multiparameter sensitivity.

items.title: Non-reciprocally interacting Ornstein-Uhlenbeck processes: Exceptional points, Anomalous relaxation, Pseudo-equilibrium and Boundary refrigeration
items.hook: At complete asymmetry, the many-body chain exhibits pseudo-equilibrium with a factorized steady-state distribution.

items.title: A photonic source with half-a-GHz single-photon flux
items.hook: A deterministic single-photon source reaches over 500 MHz of in-fibre single-photon flux.

items.title: Coincidence-based spectral engineering for spectral matching in cascaded downconversion
items.hook: Coincidence-based spectral filtering relaxes nonlinear stage constraints in cascaded downconversion sources.

items.title: Fundamental Limits of Quantum Metrology Beyond Fixed Causal Order
items.hook: Indefinite causal order does not provide an asymptotic precision advantage over optimal parallel strategies in quantum metrology.

items.title: How dipolar interactions structure molecular droplets
items.hook: We uncover the sequence of finite-size structures through which dipolar interactions reorganize molecular droplets into crystals.

items.title: Restricting the effects hides a nonphysical symmetry from every causal structure
items.hook: A single map receives three different verdicts across theories, showing conjugation symmetry marks no boundary on its own.

items.title: Compiling the 2D Fermi-Hubbard ground-state energy estimation algorithm for active volume quantum architectures
items.hook: We achieve up to a 3.9x reduction in active volume for Fermi-Hubbard ground-state energy estimation on 2D lattices.

items.title: SAR and InSAR Change Detection with Quantum Generative Models
items.hook: Quantum circuit Born machine estimators achieved a filtered F1 score of 0.32 compared to 0.16 and 0.24 for classical baselines.

items.title: Memory-Optimal Sequential Synthesis of Multimode Gaussian Transformations
items.hook: Gaussian transformations on D-dimensional lattices can be realized sequentially using O(N^((D-1)/D)) memory qumodes.

items.title: Quantum-State Texture Dynamics: Theory and Experiment
items.hook: Quantum-state texture response to any finite-dimensional channel is fully encoded in the dual evolution of a single reference state.

items.title: Quantum communication and Bell nonlocality require infinite classical communication to simulate
items.hook: Simulating quantum correlations for systems of dimension 4 or higher requires infinite classical communication.

items.title: Measurements on the separated subsystems of an entangled state
items.hook: A new framework explains quantum nonlocality without needing to invoke random wave-function collapse.

items.title: Twin-photon generation in a silicon nitride microresonator
items.hook: A new silicon nitride chip generates twin photons at telecommunication wavelengths for scalable quantum tech.

items.title: Parameterised graph theory for tensor networks: entanglement rerouting, structural simplification, and agnostic tomography
items.hook: New graph-theory bounds reveal exactly how complex it is to learn and represent quantum tensor networks.

items.title: Vanilla Exact Synthesis of CNOT Circuits is NP-hard
items.hook: Finding the smallest circuit of CNOT gates to perform a specific task is officially NP-hard.

items.title: Spurious quantum correlations
items.hook: Some 'quantum' correlations aren't uniquely quantum; they can have natural classical explanations in different settings.

items.title: Efficient Conversion of Optical to Mechanical States Close to the Single-Quantum Level
items.hook: Achieved a record-level photon-phonon conversion efficiency of 0.76 near the single-quantum level.

items.title: Characterizing Large Scale Quantum Systems with Error Per Circuit Layer
items.hook: Error Per Circuit Layer (EPCL) measures large quantum system performance without heavy classical simulations.

items.title: Quantum thermalization achieves optimal approximate quantum error correction
items.hook: Universal relationship found showing finite-temperature thermalization saturates the quantum Singleton bound.

items.title: Non-local Magic: closed-form solution and equivalence with magic of purification
items.hook: Non-local magic of a bipartite quantum state admits an exact closed-form analytic solution via Schmidt spectrum.

items.title: Non-Abelian string melting and thermalization in an open lattice gauge theory
items.hook: We simulate a non-Abelian SU(2) lattice gauge theory, finding thermal string melting and a non-monotonic thermalization time.

items.title: Real-Time String Dynamics in $3+1$D Lattice Quantum Electrodynamics
items.hook: We present the first real-time simulations of string breaking in 3+1D lattice quantum electrodynamics using tree tensor networks.

items.title: Gravitationally Induced Entanglement Across an Event Horizon
items.hook: Particles inside and outside a black hole event horizon can actually entangle dynamically from scratch.

items.title: Effective Hamiltonian description on monitored Majorana chains: correlated power-law hoppings and unconventional entanglement scaling
items.hook: Monitored quantum chains can display unconventional entanglement entropy growing as the square of the log of system size.

items.title: Frequency-Multiplexed Parallel Gates for Quantum LDPC Codes in a Two-Dimensional Ion Crystal
items.hook: Frequency-multiplexed parallel gates achieve a logical error rate of 10^-12 for 512 ions in a 2D crystal.

items.title: A quantum oracle separation between QMA(2) and QMA
items.hook: We prove that QMA and QMA(2) are unequal by finding a quantum oracle separation.

items.title: Exponential speedup of polarization stabilization for long distance DWDM quantum networks
items.hook: Achieved continuous closed-loop polarization stabilization for over 24 hours without classical reference light on a 133 km fibre testbed.

items.title: Effective Sub-Quantum Readout for Non-Monochromatic Axion Signals in High-$Q$ Haloscopes
items.hook: Halved the Standard Quantum Limit noise floor down to 0.5 quanta per frequency bin for axion dark matter searches.

items.title: Model-level synthetic-flux control of hyperchaos order and matched-resource sensing in dissipative optomechanics
items.hook: A synthetic-flux phase selects hyperchaos transitions up to four simultaneously unstable Lyapunov directions.

items.title: Variational preparation of thermofield double states for SYK models via multi-angle QAOA: sequential angle pruning for circuit reduction
items.hook: Pruning 88.8% to 92.1% of circuit operations keeps 95% fidelity for quantum thermofield double states.

items.title: Phonon-limited detection thresholds for genetically encoded fluorescent-protein spin-qubit relaxometry of neural radicals
items.hook: Native room-temperature fluorescent protein sensors fall short of physiological sensitivity by six to eight orders of magnitude.

items.title: Observable- and state-selective prethermalization and bounds on prethermal lifetimes
items.hook: Spectral scale separation does not guarantee prethermalization; some observables relax directly while others exhibit plateaus.

items.title: Depth-1 expanders on the unitary group and applications
items.hook: We construct a constant-degree and constant-gap quantum expander on n qubits implemented by depth-1 1D circuits.

items.title: Irreducibility and regularisation properties of Gaussian quantum Markov semigroups
items.hook: Irreducibility is strictly stronger than conditions ensuring regularisation in Gaussian quantum Markov semigroups.

items.title: Quantum Weighted Moving Average for Predicting Limit Order Book Trends
items.hook: We introduce the quantum weighted moving average model for predicting price trends from limit order book data.

items.title: Behavioral Memory under Symmetry in One-Way Quantum Automata
items.hook: Noncommutativity in quantum automata exacts a one-state worst-case classical price.

items.title: Verifiable quantum advantage in extremely low depth
items.hook: Shallow quantum circuits can solve classically hard sampling problems efficiently and verifiably.

items.title: Quantum Simulation of Markovian and Non-Markovian Open Quantum Dynamics in Heavy-Ion Collisions
items.hook: New quantum computing framework simulates open-quantum-system dynamics including memory effects in heavy-ion collisions.

items.title: Efficient search for excitable zero-modes in constrained systems
items.hook: An efficient protocol finds analytical expressions for translation-invariant excitable zero-modes in constrained systems.

items.title: Bosonic codes from compact phase spaces
items.hook: Proves a fundamental no-go theorem showing stabilizer groups are non-amenable on genus-two Riemann surfaces.

items.title: Engineering multi-photon dissipation with a dc-voltage-biased Josephson junction
items.hook: Engineered multi-photon dissipation using a dc-voltage-biased SQUID to avoid parasitic nonlinear terms.

items.title: "Train classical, deploy quantum" requires rethinking generalization
items.hook: Quantum generative models trained with moment-matching show worse generalization than likelihood-trained models.

items.title: Unconditional Certified Randomness without Structure
items.hook: We achieve unconditional certified randomness in the quantum random oracle model against subexponential queries.
